verified_result: At the pinned commit, a server that accepts a discover opener creates the Peer and calls require_request_metadata before ordinary serving. For every subsequent non-Initialize request, ServerHandler::handle_request sets requires_request_metadata=true when the peer flag is set. It then validates the request _meta against ProtocolVersion::V_2026_07_28 before method dispatch; if missing_required_keys is nonempty it returns INVALID_PARAMS with the missing/malformed field names. The 2026-07-28 required keys are io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities; clientInfo is optional. Therefore the first ordinary post-discover request is rejected exactly when either required key is absent or malformed. A direct/session path that did not set request_metadata_required may omit per-request metadata unless the request is itself discover or declares protocolVersion 2026-07-28+ in its own _meta.
